title: Count the actual calls before simplifying the bound
obstacle: An asymptotic estimate is available, but the connection to the program calls, repetitions or per-level costs is unclear.
procedure: Recover a finite sum or recurrence from the executed structure, including local work, base cases and repeated calls.
Group contributions only after checking coverage and multiplicity. Keep the parameters needed by the target.
Use uniform bounds and solve or simplify the resulting expression to the accuracy requested by the source.
verification: Trace a small nontrivial input through the count and justify the general aggregation with the same program structure.
positive_example: A divide-and-conquer evaluator charges both recursive calls and its local combine step before summing by depth.
negative_example: Proving the price of a single call per level drops work if the program executes several; an upper estimate cannot supply a requested exact count.

evidence.note: General design guidance. Check its conditions in the current argument; no comparative performance claim.
